```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(haven)     # for reading .dta files
library(readxl)    # for reading Excel files
install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)     # for data manipulation
#install.packages("writexl")
library(writexl)
#install.packages ("tidyr")
library(tidyr)
#install.packages ("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(survival)
#install.packages("pheatmap")
library(pheatmap)
#install.packages("reshape2")
library(reshape2)

```



```{r cars}
da.CpGs
# Step 1: Your list of 30 CpGs
cpg_list <- c("cg07839457", "cg11699125", "cg16411857", "cg21979287", "cg16936953",
              "cg18942579", "cg01059398", "cg16306654", "cg09801824", "cg23387863",
              "cg03425812", "cg12828896", "cg00490406", "cg10636246", "cg03753191",
              "cg23904266", "cg12054453", "cg09249800", "cg08818207", "cg07878065",
              "cg02068052", "cg03957124", "cg27537252", "cg01409343", "cg13575798",
              "cg24741430", "cg04176813", "cg26140475", "cg14496081", "cg07830828")

# Step 2: Filter to just those 30 CpGs
da.CpG_30 <- da.CpGs[, colnames(da.CpGs) %in% cpg_list]
da.CpG_30


# Compute CpG-to-CpG correlation matrix
cpg_cor <- cor(da.CpG_30, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

png("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/cpg_correlation_heatmap.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)
Heatmap(
  cpg_cor,
  name = "Spearman R",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

dev.off()

# Example from earlier:
cpg_dist <- dist(cpg_cor)
cpg_tree <- hclust(cpg_dist, method = "complete")
cluster_labels <- cutree(cpg_tree, k = 3)  # This assigns 3 clusters

Heatmap(cpg_cor,
        name = "Spearman R",
        col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
        row_split = cluster_labels,
        column_split = cluster_labels,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),  
        row_names_max_width = unit(11, "cm") 
)



```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
# Compute distance and clustering
cpg_dist <- dist(cpg_cor)
cpg_tree <- hclust(cpg_dist, method = "complete")
cluster_labels_raw <- cutree(cpg_tree, k = 3)

# Set desired cluster display order (e.g., show cluster 2 first)
desired_order <- c(2, 1, 3)

# Convert to factor with desired order
cluster_labels <- factor(cluster_labels_raw, levels = desired_order)

png("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/clustering_heatmap.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)
# Generate heatmap
Heatmap(
  cpg_cor,
  name = "Spearman R",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
  row_split = cluster_labels,
  column_split = cluster_labels,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)
dev.off()

```

```{r}



# Compute distance and clustering
cpg_dist <- dist(cpg_cor)
cpg_tree <- hclust(cpg_dist, method = "complete")
cluster_labels_raw <- cutree(cpg_tree, k = 3)

# Set desired cluster display order (e.g., show cluster 2 first)
desired_order <- c(2, 1, 3)
cluster_labels <- factor(cluster_labels_raw, levels = desired_order)

# Define cluster colors (choose as you'd like)
cluster_colors <- c("1" = "#F5c26B",  # Yellow
                    "2" = "#80bbdb",  # green
                    "3" = "#e8bac8")  # red

# Add row and column annotations
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Cluster = as.character(cluster_labels),
  col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster = as.character(cluster_labels),
  col = list(Cluster = cluster_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# Save heatmap with annotations
png("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/clustering_heatmap_annotated.png",
    width = 4000, height = 4000, res = 600)

Heatmap(
  cpg_cor,
  name = "Spearman R",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
  row_split = cluster_labels,
  column_split = cluster_labels,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  top_annotation = col_ha,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

dev.off()

                  

```


```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
